meta.name: alfworld-search-pattern-executor
meta.description: Systematically searches a sequence of likely locations for a target object based on common sense. Use when you need to find a specific object and know which receptacles to check but not which one contains it. Takes a list of candidate receptacles, orchestrates navigation and inspection, and outputs when the target is found or all locations are exhausted.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按常识依次搜索多个位置找到目标物品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个可能位置中逐一查找某个物品。
copy.tagline_en: Search likely locations systematically to find a target object.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to check multiple possible locations for a specific object.

howto.what: 装上后，当你让Claude找某个物品并列出可能的位置时，它会按顺序逐个前往、打开并检查，找到后取出；若全无则报告未找到。
howto.when: 当你明确要求寻找一个具体物体，并提供一系列可能存放该物体的容器或位置（如抽屉、柜子等）时触发。

say.text: 在客厅找遥控器，查沙发、茶几、电视柜。
找钥匙，翻床头柜、书桌和衣柜。
say.note: 顺序搜索并关闭打开过的柜子。

say.text: 帮我找剪刀，看看厨房抽屉和架子。
say.note: 找不到会告诉你没找到。

howto.what_en: When installed, if you ask Claude to find a specific object and list possible locations, it will sequentially navigate to each, open if closed, inspect, take the object if found, or report not found after exhausting all candidates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask to locate an object and provide a list of candidate receptacles or locations to search.

say_en.text: Find the remote in the living room, check sofa, coffee table, TV stand.
say_en.note: Claude will search these locations in order.

say_en.text: Look for keys, check nightstand, desk, and wardrobe.
Help me find scissors, check kitchen drawers and shelves.
